summary: The `no_valid_comparison` closure holds. All 74 source files matched their recorded sizes and hashes, and all five proposed computations reproduced. Table S1 contains 159 selected maternal-effect rows, but its published contrast weights do not establish a common effect across the 38 saline offspring. Figure 5 reports males and females separately. The corrected proposal makes that uncertainty explicit, accepts a future matching contrast in either documented direction, and preserves the earlier DOCX retrieval record. [Article](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11283907/) · [Supplement](https://databank.illinois.edu/datasets/IDB-8635710)
openIssues: Author concordance remains unassessed until a gene-level author result or documented fitted contrast identifies the common sex-adjusted maternal effect within saline.
